item.title: Alexandria man, known child predator to serve over 2 decades in prison for sharing, possessing CSAM
item.description: An Alexandria man and previously convicted child predator will spend over two decades in prison for both sharing and possessing child sexual abuse material (CSAM), including images of toddlers being abused.

item.title: 'Lives they should still be living': Families remember three JMU students killed in crash three years later
item.description: It’s been three years since three James Madison University students were killed in a car crash after an unregistered fraternity event. Their families miss them every day.

item.title: Owner of troubled No Limit Towing to serve more than 2 years for forgery, issuing a bad check
item.description: The owner of the troubled No Limit Towing & Recovery, who is accused of stealing cars and money from citizens over several years, will serve just over 2 years in prison after she pleaded guilty to some of the charges she faces in Caroline County.

item.title: As snow melts, Virginia lawmakers seek alternatives and awareness to road salt
item.description: Two Virginia lawmakers have introduced legislation that aims to find alternatives for road salt and raise awareness about its environmental impact.

item.title: More than 300 children still missing out of Virginia this National Missing Persons Day
item.description: More than 300 children are currently missing out of Virginia this National Missing Persons Day.

item.title: Central Va. parents frustrated by extended school closures
item.description: Parents of students at Central Virginia schools are frustrated as inclement weather conditions keep some schools closed for a second week.

item.title: LIST: Central Virginia schools going virtual, delayed on Wednesday due to dangerous roads
item.description: Some Central Virginia school districts will shift to virtual learning or operate on a two-hour delay on Wednesday due to dangerous roads.

item.description: A dog was found shot dead between two Richmond buildings on Monday.

item.title: Only On 8: Richmond mother, children lose everything in apartment fire
item.description: A Richmond mother says all of her family's belongings were destroyed after a fire burned through Ashley Oaks Apartments Monday afternoon, displacing dozens of residents.
